spans.s: कु—तनय m. a degenerate son, Pañcat.
See 1. कु.
कु—तनु m. ‘deformed’, N. of Kubera (this deity being of a monstrous appearance, having three legs and but eight teeth), L.
&c. See ib.
कु—तन्त्री f. tail, MBh. xii, 5355 and 5363.
कु—तप mfn. slightly hot, W.
कु—तप m. n. (g. अर्धर्चादि) a sort of blanket (made of the hair of the mountain goat), Gaut.; Mn.; Yājñ.; VarBṛS.
कु—तप m. the Kuśa grass (Poa cynosuroides), Hcat.

the eighth Muhūrta or portion of the day from the last Daṇḍa of the second watch to the first of the third or about noon (an eligible time for the performance of sacrifices to the Manes), MBh. xiii, 6040; MatsyaP.
grain, L.
a daughter's son, L.
a sister's son, L.
a twice-born man (one of the first three classes), L.
a Brāhman, L.
a guest, L.
the sun, L.
fire, L.
an ox, L.
a kind of musical instrument, L.
&c. See ib.
कु—तप-विन्यास m. arranging musical instruments and musicians, Bhar.
कु—तप—सप्तक n. a Śrāddha in which seven constituents occur (viz. noon, a horn platter, a Nepāl blanket, silver, sacrificial grass, Sesamum, and kine), W.
कु—तप—सौश्रुत m. N. of a man g. पार्थिवादि.
कु—तप-हार m. a partic. implement, (prob.) a sickle, Baudh.
कु—तपस्विन् m. a wicked or bad ascetic, Pañcat.
कु—तर्क m. fallacious argument, sophistry, BhP.; MārkP.
a bad logician, KapS. vi, 34
कु—तर्क—पथ m. ‘the way of sophists’, a sophistical method of arguing, Rājat. v, 378.
कु—तापस m. a wicked ascetic, Kathās.
&c. See 1. कु.
कु—तापसी f. a wicked female ascetic, ib.
कु—तार्किक m. a bad logician.
कु—तित्तिरि m. a species of bird resembling the partridge, Suśr.
कु—तीर्थ m. a bad teacher.
कु—तुम्बुक m. a kind of pot-herb, Car.
&c. See 1. कु.
कु—तुम्बुरु n. a bad fruit of the plant Diospyros embryopteris, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 143, Kāś.
कु—तृण n. water houseleek (Pistia Stratiotes), L.
See 1. कु.
a Sautra root (i.e. one found in grammatical Sūtras only), to spread.
N. of one of the eighteen attendants of the sun (identified with the god of the ocean), L.
, from whom? (for the abl. case of 2. क॑), RV. i, 164, 18; AV. viii, 9, 4
(कुतः कालात्, since what time? VP.)
from where? whence? RV. &c.
whereto? in which direction? BhP. viii, 19, 34
(आ कुतस्, up to where? Pat.)
where? R. vii, 23, 3
wherefore? why? from what cause or motive? because, Lāṭy. &c. (often in dramas before verses giving the reason of what precedes)
how? in what manner? ChUp. &c.

how much less? much less, ChUp.; MuṇḍUp.; MBh. &c. In अ-कुतस्, which occurs in comp., कुतस् has an indefinite sense (e.g. अ-कुतो-मृत्यु, not fearing death from any quarter, BhP. iii, 17, 19; cf. अ-कुतोभय)

is also indefinite when connected with the particles अपि, चिद्, चन (e.g. कुतो ऽपि, from any quarter, from any cause, Pañcat.; कुतो ऽपि कारणात्, from any cause, Prab.; कुतश्-चिद्, from any one, from anywhere, RV.; KaṭhUp. &c. (cf. अकुतश्चिद्-भय); कुतश् चन, (with a negation preceding) from no side, RV.; TUp. &c.; to no side, R. v, 74, 21; यतः कुतश्-चिद् from any person soever Comm. on KātyŚr.)
coming from whence, i.e. not possible, Bhadrab.
कुतस्—तराम् ind. how? in what manner? KapS. i, 80.
कुतस्—त्य mfn. coming from where? Uttarar.; Prasannar.
(with अपि) of unknown origin, Uttarar.
(in comp. for कुतस्).
कुतो—निमित्त mfn. having what cause or reason? R. ii, 74, 17.
कुतो—मूल mfn. having what origin? MBh. i, 6205; Car.
(for ˚तस्-त्य ?), N. of a man Comm. on TāṇḍyaBr. (cf. कौतस्त.)
N. of one of the Ṛṣis of the Sāma-veda, ĀrṣBr.
curiosity, Rājat. viii, 1613
eagerness, desire for (in comp.), Gīt. i, 42 (cf. कौतुक.)
curious, inquisitive, Prasannar.
id., Naiṣ. ii, 35.
a small कुतू, or leathern oil-bottle, Pāṇ. v, 3, 89
n. the eighth Muhūrta of the day (= कु-तप, q.v.), L.
a leathern oil-bottle, Pāṇ. v, 3, 89.
, curiosity, interest in any extraordinary matter, Sāh. &c.
inclination, desire for (प्रति loc. or in comp.), Śak. &c.
eagerness, impetuosity
what excites curiosity, anything interesting, fun, Pañcat.
surprising, wonderful, W.
excellent, celebrated, W. (cf. कौतूहल.)
कुतूहल—कृत् mfn. exciting curiosity, Hcar.
कुतूहल—वत् mfn. curious, taking interest in anything, Mālav.
a room for recreation, Divyāv.
g. तारकादि.
curious, highly interested in anything, Mn. iv, 63 &c.
eager, impatient.
(in astron.) the fifteenth Yoga, VarBṛ.
, where? whereto? in which case? when? RV. &c.
wherefore? Pañcat.; Hit.

कुत्र-क्व, where (this) -where (that) i.e. how distant or how different is this from that, how little is this consistent with that? BhP. vii, 9, 25. कुत्र becomes indefinite when connected with the particles अपि, चिद्, e.g. कुत्रापि, anywhere, somewhere, wherever, to any place, wheresoever, Pañcat.; MārkP.
चिद् [RV.] or कुत्र चिद् [R. &c.], anywhere, somewhere, wheresoever
कुत्र चिद्, nowhere, to no place whatsoever, MBh.; Pañcat.
= कस्मिंश्-चिद्, e.g. कुत्र चिद् अरण्ये, in a certain wood, Pañcat.
चिद्-कुत्र चिद्, in one case-in the other case, sometimes-sometimes, Mn. ix, 34
कुत्र चिद्, wherever it be, here or there Comm. on KapS. i, 69.
कुत्र—त्य mfn. where living or residing? BhP.; Daś.

(perhaps related to कु॑तस्) cl. 10. P. कुत्सयति [also Ā. ˚यते, Dhātup.; rarely cl. 1. P. कुत्सति, MBh. ii, 2298 and 2303; once cl. 4. P. कुत्स्यति, R. vii, 43, 18], to despise, abuse, revile, contemn, Mn.; Yājñ.; &c.;
abuse, reviling, reproach, Pāṇ.; Mn. iv, 163
reproachful or abusive expression, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 53
an expression of contempt, Nir. ii, 3.
reproach, contempt, Pāṇ.; MBh.

N. of a Ṛṣi (called Ārjuneya, author of several hymns of the RV.; when attacked by the demon Śuṣṇa, Indra defended him and killed the demon; but in other hymns [RV. i, 53, 10; ii, 14, 7; iv, 26, 1; viii, 53, 2] Kutsa is represented as persecuted by Indra), RV.; AV. iv, 29, 5; TāṇḍyaBr.
N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras (author of the hymns, RV. i, 94-98; 100-115; ix, 97, 45 seqq.), ĀśvŚr.
lightning, thunderbolt, Naigh.; Nir.
(also) a distance of about 30 inches, L.
(आस्), m. pl. (Pāṇ. ii, 4, 65) the descendants or the family of Kutsa, RV. vii, 25, 5; Lāṭy.
(अम्), n. the plant Costus speciosus or arabicus, L.; (cf. कौ॑त्स, पुरु-कु॑त्स, &c.)
instr. contemptuously, Kathās. lxi, 298.
despised, reviled, contemptible, vile, Nir.; Pāṇ.; MBh. &c.
the grass Cyperus, L.
कुत्सी-√ भू to become subject to reproach Comm. on Nir. vi, 30.
1. कुत्स्य mfn. blamable, Bhartṛ.
2. कुत्स्य॑ m. N. of the Ṛṣi Kutsa, RV. iv, 16, 12.
1. and 2. कुत्स्य . See √ कुत्स् and कु॑त्स.
कुत्स—कुशिकिका f. the intermarriage of the Kutsa and Kuśika families, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 125, Kāś.
कुत्स—पुत्र॑ m. a son of Kutsa, RV. x, 105, 11.
कुत्स—वत्स॑ m. id., ib.
N. of a man, MaitrUp. (cf. कौत्सायन.)
the indigo plant, L.
See पुरु-क्˚.
, a fissure in the earth Comm. on KātyŚr. xv, 1, 10.
pl. N. of particular waters, Kāṭh. xxx, 6
